text:
Priya: quick sync — customer asks for different rate/quotas per model size (tiny/base/large). Do we want: per-model buckets, weighted-token units, or hybrid with burst reservoirs? Thoughts?

Sam: weighted-token units. keep single quota counter but multiply tokens by model_cost_multiplier. simplest for API and billing.

Anika: weighted tokens OK, but we also need hard caps per-model to prevent runaway on expensive models. UX must let admins set overrides per model.

Devin: agree on hard caps. also we should support short bursts: give each org a small reservoir that refills at a steady rate so normal spikes don't 403 immediately. reservoir_size = burst_multiplier * steady_rate.

Mitesh: telemetry note: we MUST log model_id, token_count, applied_weight, rule_id, and matched_action (throttle/allow/soft-limit) for every request so SRE + billing can debug. metric names: quota.eval, quota.denied.reason, quota.reservoir.

Sam: API response headers proposal (short):

```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 5234
X-RateLimit-ModelWeight-Remaining: 1200  # tokens weighted by model
X-Quota-Rule: model_size_large_override_v2
```

Anika: console UX idea: "Model Quotas" tab -> table with columns: model family, weight multiplier, monthly hard cap, burst allowance, last 7d usage, set override (toggle). Also show "Projected monthly cost impact" when changing weights.

Priya: edge cases: fine-tuned variants should inherit family defaults unless admin explicitly sets variant override. also need to define precedence: per-key override > per-org default > family default.

Devin: on algorithm details: reservoir refill should be token-based (weighted tokens). refill_rate = steady_tokens_per_minute * weight_of_most_used_model? maybe simpler: refill by weighted tokens consumed historically. we can iterate.

Mitesh: add a debug flag to telemetry + UI to show which quota branch matched for a request id. also store last 24h sample for support.

Sam: SDK change: surface the new headers and normalize weight so clients can show meaningful remaining quota. docs example will show how to compute remaining minutes.

quota-bot: rollout notice — to canary (10% orgs) starting 1764009000. New quota engine will emit `quota.rule.id` event to event-log.

Anika: worry: mixing weighted tokens + hard caps might confuse customers. We should have a short copy in console: "Weights adjust quota usage for expensive models — hard caps still block absolute consumption." add FAQ link.

Priya: ok action items: I will prototype API header changes + console mock. Devin will prototype reservoir algorithm and perf impact. Mitesh will draft telemetry schema and events. Sam will draft SDK + docs changes. We'll sync Wednesday. :+1:

Sam: cool — I'll also add a small CLI tool to simulate quota usage by model to validate refill math.

Priya: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for any follow-ups. :eyes:
